name: devlife-simulator
author: DevLife Studio
description: The Architect: Source Code of a Life - A narrative-driven game about a Vietnamese developer's journey

scripts.electron:build: bun run build:web && bun run electron:compile
scripts.release:macos: bun run build:web && bun run electron:compile && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.release:windows: bun run build:web && bun run electron:compile && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release:android:apk: bun run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.release:android:aab: bun run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
